name: explore-model
description: Runs the built-in Explore subagent on a chosen model and effort (default Haiku, medium) whenever the Agent call leaves them out. Keeps Anthropic's Explore prompt and read-only tools; a call that names its own model or effort keeps it. Needs function hooks (early access).

model.title: Explore model
model.description: Model for Explore subagents whose Agent call names none

effort.title: Explore effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for Explore subagents whose Agent call names none
